My account shows a negative balance of $171.85. I also received an email saying a support case was closed, without an explanation of how my concerns were resolved.

Small businesses need timely communication and clear answers when their earnings are affected. I am asking Booksy to review my evidence and provide a meaningful response.

reviews.title: Booksy User Since 2019 – Chargeback Cases and No Final Answers
reviews.text:
Booksy User Since 2019 – Four Chargeback Cases and No Final Answers

I have been a loyal, paying Booksy business user since 2019, and after nearly seven years with this platform, I am extremely disappointed with the lack of communication, transparency, and support regarding chargeback disputes.

I have experienced FOUR chargeback cases, and I have NEVER received a clear final resolution or explanation regarding ANY of them.

Booksy requests extensive supporting evidence from business owners, including screenshots, client conversations, signed consent forms, booking confirmations, and proof that clients acknowledged and accepted our cancellation and non-refundable deposit policies.

We spend hours gathering, organizing, and submitting everything requested. And then what? No proper updates, no final decisions communicated, no explanations, and no meaningful follow-up.

There is also no effective way to communicate directly with the chargeback department by phone. In my experience, everything depends on emails that fail to provide clear answers.

I have previously lost more than $140 in disputed funds without receiving a proper explanation of the outcome.

What makes this particularly frustrating is that Booksy itself allows businesses to establish cancellation policies and require non-refundable deposits. Yet when clients dispute those transactions, business owners face financial losses, including an additional $20 chargeback fee.

Are we supposed to disregard our own business

reviews.title: Nie polecam!
reviews.text:
Ogromne rozczarowanie po przejściu z Versum na Booksy Biz!
Przez ponad 10 lat korzystaliśmy z Versum i nigdy nie mieliśmy problemów. Po przejęciu systemu zostaliśmy zmuszeni do migracji na Booksy Biz i od początku zaczęły się problemy.
System działa bardzo wolno, jest nieintuicyjny, a na Google Chrome praktycznie w ogóle nie działa, mimo czyszczenia cookies i interwencji informatyka. Na Mozilli działa, ale tak wolno, że zwykłe umówienie pacjenta zajmuje zdecydowanie za dużo czasu.
Kolejny problem to pomoc techniczna. Konsultant stwierdził, że nie da się wydrukować miesięcznego raportu fiskalnego, a gdy zgłosiłam problem z działaniem systemu, odmówił przekazania go dalej, uznając, że dotyczy wyłącznie mnie. Co więcej, często to my musimy tłumaczyć pracownikom Booksy, jak działa ich własny system!
Zamiast ułatwiać pracę, Booksy Biz ją utrudnia i generuje niepotrzebny stres. Zrezygnowalibyśmy już dawno, gdyby nie ponad 10-letnia historia klientów i usług oraz ponad tysiąc opinii zgromadzonych na Moment.pl i Booksy.
Przejście z działającego Versum na Booksy Biz to ogromny krok wstecz. Słaba funkcjonalność, problemy techniczne i niekompetentna pomoc techniczna. Zdecydowanie nie polecamy!

reviews.title: Not good
reviews.text:
Two stars, and only because the core booking calendar works. The reason I'm leaving this review is to warn other independent barbers about the Boost feature before they turn it on.

I run an established shop with a steady book of referrals — clients my existing clients send me directly. After enabling Boost, Booksy began classifying those referred clients as Boost clients and taking a cut of their bookings, even though they came from my own network, not from Booksy's marketing. At the same time, my visibility to genuinely new clients searching the platform appears to drop unless I stay enrolled in Boost. That combination is the problem: it creates pressure to keep paying a fee on revenue that the platform did not generate.

If you are a barber with your own clientele and your own referral pipeline, understand what you are opting into. Boost is not a neutral marketing tool — it sits between you and your own clients and bills you for the privilege. The booking software is fine. The growth model attached to it is not built in the barber's favor.

I'll be moving my book elsewhere.

reviews.title: Mr
reviews.text:
⭐ 0 out of 5 stars

Booksy Took My Money for a Year and Gave Me Nothing

I've been paying £41 a month for Booksy for about a year now. That's nearly £500 down the drain, and I honestly regret every single payment.

The Main Problem

The service just doesn't work. I've tried reaching out to support several times asking for help, but nobody ever calls me back like they promise. It's incredibly frustrating.

Can't Even Get Through to Someone

I've sat on their phone line for over an hour waiting to speak to an agent. The system keeps saying there's no one available and there are 5 people ahead of me. But nothing changes. An hour passes and I'm still there. It feels like they're not even trying to help.

They Only Care About Getting You On

Booksy sends me notifications all the time about opening the app and booking more customers. But the moment I actually need their help? Radio silence. It's like they only care about taking your money, not supporting you.

Not Worth It

I feel like I've thrown nearly £500 out the window. I'm cancelling my subscription and I'm not coming back. If you're thinking about using Booksy, seriously consider other options. You'll get better service and better value somewhere else.

Don't waste your time or money on this.

reviews.title: Unreliable Platform, Overpriced Subscription
reviews.text:
The price point does not match the value, especially given the number of ongoing issues I’ve experienced since returning to Booksy.

I’ve had to open at least one support ticket every single week. Basic functions that should work reliably simply do not. Push notifications are inconsistent or completely nonfunctional, forcing me to manually open the app or constantly check my email to stay on top of appointments.

Payment processing has also been a recurring problem. Payments frequently fail, leaving me responsible for remembering to collect payment after services have already begun.

Profile visibility is another major concern. There are too many questions surrounding how and when my business is being displayed to potential clients.

For context, I actively use two other booking platforms and have not experienced a single issue with either of them.

At this point, the recurring problems are costing me time, creating unnecessary stress, and undermining my confidence in the platform. For what Booksy charges, I expect reliability in the most fundamental areas of its service.

I’m genuinely at the point of considering leaving Booksy permanently.

reviews.title: I want to warn others about Booksy Biz.
reviews.text:
For two months I have been trying to cancel my subscription and have sent four emails to customer support. I received no response or callback, while charges continue to be taken from my account.

The main issue is that users cannot cancel the subscription themselves. Unlike most modern services, cancellation is not available in the app and requires contacting support and waiting for a phone call that never comes.

There is also no clear control over payments after adding a card, and it is not transparent that users cannot remove their payment method or stop billing directly.I do not recommend this service.

reviews.title: We believe Booksy’s current policy is contradictory to the way it is advertised.
reviews.text:
Booksy states that commission is charged only on a client’s first visit. However, we operate two salons, and many of our clients visit both locations. In these cases, Booksy continues to mark those clients with the “rocket” icon and charges a commission, even though they are already existing clients within our business.

Previously, when such a situation occurred, we could confirm that the client had already visited one of our salons. However, Booksy has now changed the policy and only allows these claims to be submitted within 7 days.

This creates a clear contradiction. If the commission is truly intended to apply only to a client’s first visit, then the ability to verify that a client has already visited our business should not be limited to a 7-day window. In practice, this means that commission is not always being charged on the first visit, but rather based on whether the verification is submitted within the new deadline.

We would appreciate clarification on how this policy aligns with Booksy’s statement that commission is charged only on a client’s first visit.

reviews.title: Indignada

En concreto, me cobraron aproximadamente 580€ por el envío de enlaces de reserva a mis propios clientes, algo que en ningún momento se especifica de forma transparente dentro del programa de gestión.Además, he solicitado en repetidas ocasiones el acceso a mis datos personales y no he recibido ninguna respuesta. Tampoco han respondido a mi solicitud de baja del servicio, que ya he pedido formalmente por correo electrónico.Para mi sorpresa, tras solicitar la cancelación, han vuelto a realizar un cobro sin autorización ni explicación.Considero que la falta de transparencia, la ausencia de atención al cliente y los cobros no justificados son muy preocupantes. No recomendaría este servicio a otros profesionales hasta que mejoren estos aspectos.

reviews.title: SOLO UNA PEGA
reviews.text:
Las restricciones asociadas a cada rol de empleado vienen predefinidas y no ofrecen margen de personalización, lo que impide adaptarlas a las necesidades reales de cada empresa. Como crítica constructiva, este es un aspecto clave que debería mejorarse, permitiendo configurar de forma flexible qué puede ver o gestionar cada empleado, en lugar de limitarse a las cuatro opciones predeterminadas.

El resto del programa funciona de forma excelente, pero esta limitación es tan relevante para nosotros que reduce significativamente la valoración global.

reviews.title: Long term customer and Booksy Blocked my Boost because of new clients not showing
reviews.text: I had to cancel my account because of clients booking and not showing. I had no show policy in place and even switched to deposit. Despite all of these precautions I still wasted time and money. Eventually leading to booksy blocking my boost and receiving fewer and fewer new clients. I started a new account and the booking issues continued on this account. Leading me to being charged for a no show I didn't know I had. No notifications from booksy on the booksy app about the client or the charge. I noticed because I an extra charge had occurred in my bank account from booksy. I searched everywhere but saw no reason for the charge until I check my client list as I was about to import my clients to another platform. And that's when I saw it; a client I had never seen. They never booked, so I thought. After examining their profile I see their appointment was only a few days prior. Deposit in place; failed charge; no notification and it had not been on my books that day. Side note: I check everyday all day religiously; I had problems with not receiving push notifications from booksy. I reached out to customer service and they offered no resolution only preventative measures; which I had already done. On another point they raised the cap level for 1st time boost services; it was set at 30% up to $50 now if I'm not mistaken it's up to $100 or more. Luckily for me this was my back up booking app. Styleseat is better and they only take up to $50.
